start.greeting: 👋 Telegram News Aggregator Pick a channel — I will show its latest posts and store them.

help.hub: ❓ How to use Pick a feature — I will explain what it does, why it is useful and how to work with it.
help.commands: ⌨️ Commands /start — start over /menu — main menu /help — this guide /language — change language /trial — free trial /premium — plans /subscription — subscription status /ref — invite a friend /promo — redeem a promo code /search — search the archive /stats — link analytics

feed.title: 📰 News feed
feed.body: 📰 News feed What it is. Fresh posts from curated channels in a single list — no switching between chats. How to use. Open the section, pick a channel and browse the posts. «🔄 Refresh» pulls the latest straight from the channel. Why. Reading ten channels in a row is tiring. Here everything sits in one place, and whatever you read is kept in the archive and stays searchable.

cabinet.title: ⚙️ Your sources
cabinet.body: ⚙️ Your sources What it is. The channels the bot watches specifically for you. How to use. Workspace → «📥 My sources» → «➕ Add source», then send a link or @name. The bot checks right away that the channel exists and is readable. Why. The public channel list is shared by everyone; sources are yours — they feed your filters and auto-posting.

autopost.title: 📤 Auto-posting
autopost.body: 📤 Auto-posting What it is. The bot publishes selected posts to your channel by itself. How to use. Add the bot as an administrator with posting rights, then Workspace → «📤 Auto-posting channels» → «➕ Add channel» and forward any message from it. The bot verifies its rights and tells you whether everything is ready. Why. Running a channel stops being a daily chore: set the rules once and posts go out on their own. ⚠️ Requires an active subscription — publishing stops when it expires.

keywords.title: 🔤 Word filters
keywords.body: 🔤 Word filters What it is. Two lists: trigger words and stop words. How to use. Workspace → «🔤 Word filters». Triggers: a post is taken only if it contains at least one of them. Stop words: a post is dropped even if a trigger matched. Enter the words one per line. Why. Without filters everything lands in your feed. With them only what you actually need survives, while ads and reposts are filtered out.

search.title: 🔎 Archive search
search.body: 🔎 Archive search What it is. Full-text search across every saved post. How to use. Use /search or the menu button, then type your words. Word forms do not matter: «news» and «newest» match the same root. Wrap an exact phrase in quotes. Why. That post you saw a week ago turns up in a second — no scrolling through channel history.

stats.title: 📊 Link analytics
stats.body: 📊 Link analytics What it is. A count of clicks on links in your posts. How to use. Nothing to configure: external links are replaced with short ones when publishing, and clicks are counted. Run /stats for the report. Why. You can see which topics people actually read rather than scroll past.

subscription.title: 💳 Subscription and trial
subscription.body: 💳 Subscription and free trial What it is. The paid features — auto-posting, advanced filters and higher limits. How to use. Start with the «🎁 Free trial» — it costs nothing and includes everything. Then «⭐ Plans»: pay with Telegram Stars or crypto. Check the current state with /subscription. Why. Reading news and searching are always free. A subscription is for people running their own channel.

referral.title: 👥 Invitations
referral.body: 👥 Invitations What it is. A personal link for inviting people you know. How to use. Run /ref or tap the menu button, copy the link and send it to a friend. The moment they start the bot through it, both of you get bonus days. Why. It extends your subscription without paying for it.

promo.title: 🎟 Promo codes
promo.body: 🎟 Promo codes What it is. A code worth bonus subscription days. How to use. Run /promo and send the code in one message. Case and dashes do not matter: summer-24 and SUMMER24 are the same code. Why. Codes are handed out at launches, in promotions and by support. Each code works once per person.

onboarding.start: 👋 Агрегатор новостей и SMM-помощник 👋 News aggregator & SMM assistant Нажмите кнопку ниже, чтобы начать. Press the button below to begin.
onboarding.about: 🎯 What this bot does It watches the Telegram channels you care about, picks out only what matters, and — if you ask — publishes the selection to your own channel. Why it helps. Instead of scrolling through dozens of channels and copying posts by hand, you set up sources and keyword filters once, and the bot takes it from there. Main features: 📰 News feed — fresh posts from channels in one place ⚙️ Workspace — your own sources, auto-posting and word filters 🔎 Search — find any archived post by keywords 📊 Analytics — how many people followed your links 🎁 Free trial — try everything at no cost Every feature has a detailed explanation — see «❓ How to use» in the menu.
